name: Humanitarian principles
description: Understand humanity, impartiality, neutrality, and independence as boundaries for responsible action.
beginnerOutcome: Explain why assistance should follow need and dignity.
intermediateOutcome: Apply principles to a briefing or workshop plan.
advancedOutcome: Design review gates that protect principled action.

name: IHL and civilian protection
description: Recognize core civilian protection concepts and the importance of sourced, careful advocacy.
beginnerOutcome: Name civilian protection as a humanitarian concern.
intermediateOutcome: Use sourced language in public communication.
advancedOutcome: Prepare rights-aware briefing questions for expert review.

name: Source verification
description: Check public claims against reliable sources, dates, owners, and review status.
beginnerOutcome: Distinguish a source from an unsourced claim.
intermediateOutcome: Build a source table for a briefing.

name: Aid accountability
description: Understand feedback, transparency, safeguarding, and accountable support channels.
intermediateOutcome: Read a Transparency Passport with caveats.
advancedOutcome: Draft partner intake questions for review.

name: Safeguarding
description: Protect children and vulnerable people through protocols, supervision, consent, and referral boundaries.
beginnerOutcome: Identify why direct contact is restricted.
intermediateOutcome: Add safeguarding boundaries to a workshop plan.

name: WASH basics
description: Understand safe-water, sanitation, hygiene, and disease-prevention concepts at a non-clinical level.
beginnerOutcome: Explain why WASH affects disease prevention.

name: Public-health preparedness
description: Learn how preparedness, risk communication, and referrals support public health without giving medical advice.

name: Food and nutrition basics
description: Understand malnutrition risk, food assistance, screening concepts, and responsible support routes.
beginnerOutcome: Describe nutrition support without clinical advice.
intermediateOutcome: Compare source evidence for food security.

name: Maternal health basics
description: Understand maternal health, reproductive health, dignity, protection, and referral awareness at a non-clinical level.
beginnerOutcome: Name dignity and referral awareness as essential concerns.
intermediateOutcome: Create a safe advocacy briefing using official sources.
advancedOutcome: Design partner questions for maternal health support.

name: Education in emergencies
description: Understand temporary learning, teacher recovery, child protection, and continuity of education during crisis.
intermediateOutcome: Outline a temporary learning support plan for review.
advancedOutcome: Connect education recovery to civic repair.

name: Mental health and psychosocial support basics
description: Recognize psychosocial support principles, referral boundaries, and the need for qualified care.
intermediateOutcome: Add referral boundaries to a learning plan.

name: Conflict transformation
description: Look beyond immediate disputes to relationships, systems, narratives, and future patterns.
beginnerOutcome: Explain how action can reduce harm and build capacity.
intermediateOutcome: Map a conflict-sensitive campus action plan.
advancedOutcome: Design a multi-level peacebuilding learning pathway.

name: Dialogue facilitation
description: Facilitate careful conversations with safety, dignity, power awareness, and appropriate boundaries.
beginnerOutcome: Name when dialogue may be inappropriate.

name: Emotional intelligence
description: Use emotions as information while preventing reactive or harmful action.
intermediateOutcome: Design reflection questions for a group.
advancedOutcome: Facilitate steady, accountable action under pressure.

name: Cultural intelligence
description: Practice humility about language, custom, religion, power, identity, and local knowledge.
beginnerOutcome: Name assumptions that need local review.

name: Technology-for-good safeguards
description: Build tools with privacy, data minimization, partner review, and no exposure of sensitive people or locations.
advancedOutcome: Design a partner-governed prototype review process.

name: Scenario planning
description: Use assumptions, risks, and preparedness questions without treating scenarios as predictions.
beginnerOutcome: Explain the difference between scenarios and predictions.
advancedOutcome: Connect scenarios to partner-reviewed action triggers.

name: Youth leadership
description: Support youth agency, civic capacity, ethical communication, and social cohesion with safeguarding.
beginnerOutcome: Describe youth agency without direct-risk pathways.
intermediateOutcome: Plan a safeguarded civic learning session.
advancedOutcome: Design a partner-mediated youth leadership pathway.
